def: Google’s Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer (Raffel et al., 2019): an encoder-decoder model family, from 60M to 11B parameters, that casts every text task as text in, text out.
practice: The reference encoder-decoder: task prefixes such as ‘summarize:’ come from it, and its variants (Flan-T5, mT5) and the C4 corpus it introduced still appear in papers and pipelines.
